caption: The video captures a single lit tealight candle resting in a low round metal cup on the left side of the frame, set against a softly blurred gray wooden surface. The cup holds orange-tinted wax with a shallow melted pool surrounding a short, dark, curved wick. Throughout the excerpt the flame burns continuously, its height, width, and lean oscillating from moment to moment as the tip curves gently left and right and the body stretches and contracts. A small bright reflection of the flame sits on the wax surface, shifting and changing size in step with the flicker. The candle body, wax level, wick, and empty right two-thirds of the background remain fixed, indicating a steady camera. No other object moves within the frame. The quiet burning persists without any visible start or finish.
